title: SessionGraph — Visualize your coding agent history
excerpt: Bring your sessions from your favorite harness, explore and visualize in a graph. Compare with your friends.
content_html:
Visualize your
coding agent history

Bring all your coding agent sessions together. Visualize them in a graph and compare with your friends. Fully local and private.

Create your graph

SessionGraph reads your harness' session store, indexes it and opens a desktop app for you to play around. Everything happens locally.

Run it locally

Paste this into your terminal to open SessionGraph.

Terminal

npx sessiongraph

Prefer installer?

Supports your harness

All sources & coverage

A database for all your sessions

Search across your harnesses from one local index. Find an old conversation, pick up where you left off, or look up what changed.

MCP

Give your coding agent access to past sessions without switching apps.

“Find my sessions about invoice retries.”

search_sessions({ "query": "invoice retries" })

2 matching sessions

  • Fix duplicate invoice retriesCodex
  • Test invoice retry backoffClaude Code

REST API

Query the same index from your own scripts and tools.

Find sessions about invoice retries over HTTP.

GET /v1/search?query=invoice%20retries 

{
  "data": {
    "hits": [
      { "session": { "title": "Fix duplicate invoice retries" } },
      { "session": { "title": "Test invoice retry backoff" } }
    ],
    "total": 2
  }
}
